purpose: Prevent the next premise batch from replacing low-energy realism with short-drama secret/reversal machinery.
core_principle: A secret, mystery, reversal or unusual fact may amplify an already-working human conflict, but may not be the sole reason the story moves or the sole reason the reader cares.

mandatory_counterfactual_gate.test: Remove or delay the central secret/reveal. The premise must still contain a meaningful WANT, irreversible COST and active relationship conflict.

human_engine_requirements: At least two characters have understandable but incompatible wants before any reveal.
The protagonist must make a costly choice rather than merely investigate an answer.
The central cost must remain real even if the truth is never revealed.
The emotional conflict must be legible before the mystery is solved.
A simpler obvious action may change tactics but must not dissolve the core conflict.
At least one irreversible relationship, status, resource or moral consequence must already be in motion.
New information should reprice an existing choice; it must not manufacture the choice from nothing.
anti_overcorrection_rules: No candidate may rely primarily on presumed death, disappearance, crime, secret parentage, resurrected footage, hidden inheritance claimant or equivalent reveal device unless the non-reveal engine independently passes.
Do not add homicide, kidnapping, terminal illness, infidelity or criminal conspiracy merely to raise stakes.
Do not use a countdown or ceremony only to force characters to ignore an obvious simpler action.
Do not score a premise highly just because its one-line logline is surprising.
Do not equate mystery intensity with emotional value.
preferred_engine_sources: parent/child or sibling obligations with conflicting memories
money/property/status only when tied to relationship and self-image
a choice where either outcome costs something the character genuinely values
social consequences that cannot be undone by simply learning the truth
next_action: Use PHASE408_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_PREMISE_CONTRACT_V2 for any future Phase408 premise generation.
